scenes.direction_en: The square is being swept. Long tables are still separated, with small piles of borrowed chairs beside them.
scenes.purpose_tr: Mercenary Captain sonrası günlük yaşam; meydandaki korku mizahın hedefi değildir.

lines.text_en: The square has been loud with orders for days. Now the loudest order is where to put a chair.
Not there. The leg will catch in the drain.
Then we put the short people at that end. They will not notice.
They will notice falling over.
A table that applauds when you sit down. Very festive.
I have brought a contribution.
Is it meant to be making that noise?
That is a cooking noise.
We will discover what it is called when it reaches a bowl.
A helper carries a stack of bowls past them. Everyone steps aside at a different speed.
If you have a free hand, there is work for it. If you have two, I will be delighted.

scenes.direction_en: Jori points to the tables, Nixie to the lane, Pippa to a blank song sheet. Local helpers handle the job the company does not choose.
scenes.purpose_tr: Üç plan ikişer görev oynatır. Seçilmeyen iş NPC yardımıyla tamamlanır; sahne ve encounter farkı yaratır.

lines.text_en: These boards need bracing before anyone puts hot food on them.
There are serving things waiting at the storehouse. I know the turn with the least mud.
And the last verse needs room for names of every length.
You cannot all have the same pair of hands.
You do not have to. Choose two jobs. We will finish the other together.
Nobody misses supper because we liked a different errand.
Good. I like a map with more than one useful road.

choice.prompt_en: Choose two jobs to help with.

options.text_en: Brace the tables, then help with deliveries.
options.consequence_en: Jori and Nixie scenes; battle favors steady formation and target priority.

lines.text_en: Wood first. A clear place for the bowls makes the rest easier.
Then we bring the bowls. Excellent division of worrying.
I will borrow other voices for the verse.

options.text_en: Help with deliveries, then prepare the verse.
options.consequence_en: Nixie and Pippa scenes; battle highlights reaching attackers and support.

lines.text_en: We start at the storehouse. Nothing heavy through the market steps.
Then we make room in the song for the people carrying it.
I will find someone who can hold the other end of a board.

options.text_en: Prepare the verse, then brace the tables.
options.consequence_en: Pippa and Jori scenes; battle highlights support and front-line pressure.

lines.text_en: Song first. It is harder to find a name once everyone has a mouthful.
Then the tables. It is harder to hold a bowl once everyone is on the ground.
I will make sure the serving things find us.

scenes.direction_en: Jori kneels beneath a long table. A helper holds the other end of a brace. Tools and nails are story props, not items to grind.
scenes.purpose_tr: Jori’nin zanaati insanları rahatlatır; gizli altar chains veya aile suçluluğu açıklanmaz.

lines.text_en: Hold it there. No, lower. I need the board level, not impressed.
Will it hold that many people?
It will hold the dishes. The people get chairs.
I was looking forward to standing on it.
You can disappoint yourself before the soup does it for you.
The helper laughs and stops gripping the board hard enough to shake it.
There. You can let go of that end. I have this one.
Is that your best table-making voice?
It is my voice for people putting their fingers where the hammer goes.

scenes.direction_en: The chairs do not match. Jori tests the lowest one and replaces a loose foot with a fitted wooden pad.
scenes.purpose_tr: Aitlik motifini küçük nesneyle anlatır; ekstra sosyal puan veya mobilya ekonomisi yok.

lines.text_en: Some chairs were borrowed from kitchens. One was borrowed from somewhere that owned no other furniture.
We could hide that one at the end.
We could fix it.
I like that answer. The end keeps getting all the interesting chairs.
Put your foot on the pad while I fit it. Not on my hand.
There. It does not rock now.
Leave it near the middle. Someone should get to sit close without feeling borrowed.
It is a chair. It does not ask who brought it.
She puts it where the light reaches the seat.

scenes.direction_en: The table is tested with empty bowls. The shared path leaves space for serving and for someone moving slowly.
scenes.purpose_tr: Table yardımının tamamlanması; yapı çevre prop’u, savaş shield buff’ı değildir.

lines.text_en: This gap stays open.
For the food?
For whoever carries it. And whoever cannot step over three people to sit down.
A very considerate gap.
Do not sing at it. It is already doing its job.
A helper sets the last bowl down. The table does not move.
You can hear the difference.
I prefer the part you cannot hear.

scenes.direction_en: Nixie studies the route between the storehouse and the square. She chooses a level path; no faction mystery is hidden in the map.
scenes.purpose_tr: Nixie’nin yol okuma becerisi; false map companion hikâyesi kopyalanmaz.

lines.text_en: Not the steps. A short route becomes a long route when the soup goes down it first.
The soup is not leaving my hands.
Then you have a very good reason to avoid the steps.
The bowls are fragile.
So we carry them low and stop at the turn. I will see who is coming the other way.
You make fetching bowls sound like a heroic expedition.
Everything sounds heroic until somebody asks how many bowls came back.
Nixie moves the heaviest bundle to the hand closest to the wall.

scenes.direction_en: A stack is heavier than the helper expected. Nixie asks for a pause before offering another pair of hands.
scenes.purpose_tr: Hız ve yardım arasında seçim; fetch-count farm veya kaza kaybetme cezaları yok.

lines.text_en: I can take the last stack too.
Wait. Take a breath first.
Everyone else is moving.
Then they can keep moving around us.
I have a free hand. The pot only needs one until someone starts criticizing it.
I will save my criticism for the square.
The stack changes hands without a bowl being dropped.
There. Faster without pretending it was lighter.
I thought you would tell me to hurry.
I know where we are going. We can get there with all the bowls.

scenes.direction_en: Nixie asks the helper to lead the last part of the delivery route. They learn the turn by walking it together, without a new road sign.
scenes.purpose_tr: Nixie taşıma işini devreder; Son Geçen’in yol tabelası motifi tekrarlanmaz, home/registry arc’ı çözülmez.

lines.text_en: If we need another load, can you show the next pair of hands where we went?
You are making them lead the way back?
They know the steps now. I do not have to carry every bowl to know it will arrive.
That sounds like a holiday.
Only if nobody asks me to carry the tables.
She hands over the empty sling and follows while the helper chooses the turn.
This way.
Good. It is not only my route now.

scenes.direction_en: Pippa keeps a sheet for the shared final verse. The musical activity is dialogue, not an implemented rhythm game.
scenes.purpose_tr: Şarkıya kişi tarafından sunulan isim; gerçek isim toplama veya serbest kullanıcı verisi girişi yok.

lines.text_en: Short names, long names, names that need a second breath. There is room.
Mine will spoil the rhythm.
Then the rhythm can improve itself.
A sensible rhythm. We should invite it more often.
Could I bring my mother's name instead?
If that is the name you wish us to sing.
Pippa leaves a space before writing. The guest says it once, then again slowly.
Like that?
Like that.

scenes.direction_en: A guest wants to offer a name without telling its story publicly. Pippa rehearses quietly, without insisting on performance.
scenes.purpose_tr: Names-as-witness motifinin günlük ifadesi; korku çözülmüş veya borç iptal edilmiş sayılmaz.

lines.text_en: I can give you a name. I would rather not give you the story.
I asked for one line. I did not ask for every page.
We can keep a seat where you do not have to face the square.
I might join the song. Later.
Then later is a perfectly good time for it.
Pippa rehearses the syllables softly enough that only the guest can correct them.
You changed the tune.
The name was doing nothing wrong.

scenes.direction_en: Pippa rehearses the refrain with helpers. They disagree about a note and keep singing; no magical effect is implied.
scenes.purpose_tr: Mekanik saat transferi veya büyüsel çan susturma yok; kaynaktaki toplu şarkıyı hazırlayan insanî prova.

lines.text_en: Once together. You may miss the note, but do not lose the person beside you.
I have already missed three notes.
A vigorous beginning.
Will the song still work?
It is a song, Kera. The point is that we are singing it.
Good. I was worried it needed a bottle.
The refrain wanders off-key, finds another voice, and comes back changed.
Keep that part.

scenes.direction_en: The last serving load waits inside the storehouse. Common dead block the outer lane; the supper square remains safe.
scenes.purpose_tr: B01’in üç plan varyantı; festival sırasında yeni baskın veya satıcı/insan boss yok.

lines.text_en: Stop at the storehouse door. The lane beyond it is not clear.
Leave the serving things inside. Nobody carries them through a fight.
The square can keep setting places. We will clear this turn.
The ones in front are moving when that bellbound corpse does.
And one behind them is reaching past. Read both before we commit.
We can hold the front and choose our opening.
No hurry that costs someone the road back.
The load stays on dry boards. The group steps into the lane with empty hands ready for weapons.

scenes.direction_en: After the single road battle, helpers carry serving supplies through the cleared turn. The chosen jobs and the unchosen job are all complete.
scenes.purpose_tr: Mevcut A Table for Everyone sahnesine doğrudan hazırlık; hiçbir ödül veya yemek item’i yaratılmaz.

lines.text_en: The last stack is here.
Set it on the brace. Not the edge.
The helper can show the way back if anyone needs another load.
And the verse has enough room for the new arrivals.
Then sit before somebody finds you another useful thing to do.
My contribution first.
That depends on what it is doing now.
Kera lifts the lid with the seriousness of someone presenting a thesis.

scenes.direction_en: The square is set with long tables. Every guest must bring one dish and one name.

lines.text_en: Rule of the Harvest Supper: one dish, one name. You say the name, you get a bowl.
I brought a dish. It is technically soup.
It is moving.
It is effervescent.
I will eat it! For the festival!
Nixie ate it. Nixie was fine. Nixie glowed faintly for an hour.

scenes.purpose_tr: Kaynak A Table for Everyone sahnesinin altı repliği aynen; Kera’nın çorbası ve Nixie’nin hafif parlaması korunur.

scenes.direction_en: After the canonical comic moment, Nixie sits comfortably. Her glow is temporary source narration, not a gameplay buff or illness.
scenes.purpose_tr: Kaynaktaki mizahı sürdürür; şüpheli gerçek tarif, kalıcı glow stat’ı veya sağlık tehdidi yok.

lines.text_en: It was very memorable.
That is not an accepted tasting category.
It is now.
We can put it in the program. Soup: memorable. Tables: upright.
The helper passes the next bowl. For once, no one tells them to hurry.
There is ordinary bread if you need something with fewer opinions.
I can support both kinds of food.
A scientifically fair response.

scenes.direction_en: The innkeeper explains why every traveler gets a free meal twice a day.

lines.text_en: After Crownfall, travelers stopped paying. So we stopped charging. Twice a day, a meal, no coin.
That is generous.
It is practical. A fed traveler says their name at the door. A hungry one slips past the register.
So the meal is a count.
The meal is a meal, knight. The count is a bonus.

scenes.purpose_tr: Kaynak Inn Meal sahnesinin beş repliği aynen; Fadyme/Mahmut yerleşmiş canon varlığı korunur.

scenes.direction_en: A guest pauses near a remaining seat. Bowls are being served, and the guest has offered a name without a public story.
scenes.purpose_tr: İki eşit yaklaşım; isim sunmak ile hikâyesini sahnede anlatmaya zorlamak ayrılır.

lines.text_en: I can say a name. I do not think I can sing it in front of everyone.
Speaking is allowed to remain speaking.
This seat is steady.
That is Jori's highest recommendation.
You can sit before deciding how loud to be.
There is room to pass behind the chair.
The guest touches the back of the chair, then looks toward the open square.

choice.prompt_en: How should the company make room?

options.text_en: Invite them into the table conversation.
options.consequence_en: A gentle invitation; the guest may still decline the song.

lines.text_en: We are comparing the chairs. You can help us settle the matter.
There is no matter. They are all chairs.
That is one side of the argument.
This one is a very good chair.
A decisive answer.

options.text_en: Keep them company without asking for a story.
options.consequence_en: A quiet seat; joining the song remains their decision.

lines.text_en: I will sit here for a moment.
You do not have to.
I know. I would like to.
I will bring the bread within reach.
The guest sits. The silence does not ask them to fill it.

scenes.direction_en: The earlier invited guest comes to the square beside the company. Nobody asks them to lead.
scenes.purpose_tr: Join tercihi callback’i; ortak Last Song sahnesine bağlanır.

lines.text_en: Are you still arguing about the chairs?
We have moved on to bowls.
There is still no argument.
Stay here if you like. The song starts from wherever you are standing.
The guest stays close enough to hear a familiar voice.

scenes.direction_en: The quiet guest approaches the edge of the square. Fadyme does not turn their presence into a confession.
scenes.purpose_tr: Quiet tercihi callback’i; ortak Last Song sahnesine bağlanır.

lines.text_en: I thought I might listen from here.
It is a good place to listen.
Nobody needs to move closer.
If you want to join, you will hear where your line belongs.
The guest keeps the space they chose. The song can reach it.

scenes.direction_en: Late night. Pippa leads the square in a song of every name collected.

lines.text_en: Last verse! Everyone who brought a name, sing it with me!
Two hundred voices, off-key and loud. Somewhere, a bell rang, and nobody stopped singing.
The bell cannot count a square this loud. For one night, it is losing.

scenes.purpose_tr: Kaynak Last Song sahnesinin üç repliği aynen. Fadyme’nin iç sözü mecazdır; gerçek çan mekanizmasını iptal eden effect değildir.

scenes.direction_en: The crowd disperses slowly. Pippa closes the song sheet; Jori listens for the tables moving and hears only chairs.
scenes.purpose_tr: Büyük duygusal reveal yok; Fadyme’nin hastalığı ve royal adı bu event’te ifşa edilmez.

lines.text_en: The verse ends before the square decides to become quiet.
They kept the long name in time.
Mostly.
Mostly is a generous place to meet.
Nobody spilled a bowl when they stood up.
That is not solely the table's achievement.
You may share the credit with the soup.
For a moment Mahmut looks at the empty bowls instead of the road out.
We should help put these away.
After you have finished sitting down.

scenes.direction_en: A short conversation can happen before clearing the square. All three choices lead to the same ending.
scenes.purpose_tr: Üç kısa kapanış anı; ownership, trust puanı veya ödül tercihi yok.

lines.text_en: One last useful thing. A conversation nobody has to carry.
You make everything sound like work.
Only the enjoyable work.

choice.prompt_en: Whose small success do you notice?

options.consequence_en: Talk about making a place that follows a person.

lines.text_en: It did not move once.
The pad fits.
Someone sat in the middle instead of hiding it at the end.
That was the useful part.
Jori turns the chair to face the table again.
Leave it here. Somebody will need it tomorrow.

options.consequence_en: Talk about a route others can use without her.

lines.text_en: The helper found the storehouse without calling you.
Good. They remembered the turn.
And you got to sit down.
I thought I would be checking the turn all evening.
She starts to rise for the next load, then sees the helper already teaching someone else the route.
Tomorrow I may draw a very good route to breakfast.

options.consequence_en: Talk about letting a song belong to more than its singer.

lines.text_en: Are you keeping the wrong notes?
They were somebody's way of getting into the song.
Mine was particularly inventive.
I have made a respectful note of it.
Pippa folds the sheet with the corrections still visible.
I will not make it tidier than the evening was.

scenes.direction_en: The group clears dishes but leaves the repaired tables. A shared feast changes no magical law and reveals no plot secret.
scenes.purpose_tr: Ortak bitiş; ilk event tamamlanması burada, canon fiziksel çan/borç sonucu değişmez.

lines.text_en: The bowls go back in stacks. The chairs go back one at a time, except the repaired one.
That one can stay.
It will need a dry place if it rains.
There is a very good way to the storehouse.
And there is room left on the next sheet.
I may revise my contribution.
A table for everyone. A pot for the very brave.
Come on. Before she explains the recipe.
They leave a clear space between the tables. It will be useful when someone arrives tomorrow.

compatibility_note_tr: Story exports mevcut StoryScene grammar; graph/encounter JSON authoring formatıdır. Medya/roster ve server adapter sonraki aşama.
